name: Oyassan
source:
Age: In his 40s (exact age unknown) 
Hobbies: Inviting recipes 
Likes: Drinking after work 

The manager of the ramen shop with the nickname of "Noodle Graveyard", which has been named after all the horrible dishes served there. His true identity is a highly skilled Disobeyer. In a regular company structure, he would be in position to supervise [url=https://vndb.org/c50516]Yuu[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c50523]Suzunari[/url] and many others, representing the Disobeyers in the region. 

He Is best friends with Yuu's and Jun's fathers and treats their children like his own.

[From the Official Artbook]
